previous_disclosures.section: Accounting Firm > Unsecured Borrowings > Unsecured Short-Term Borrowings
previous_disclosures.summary: The firm accounts for certain hybrid financial instruments at fair value under the fair value option and designates certain derivatives as fair value hedges to convert fixed-rate unsecured short-term borrowings into floating-rate obligations. comparisons.peer_summary: Short-term borrowings and long-term debt are generally accounted for at amortized cost, with exceptions for fair value elections and hedging relationships. Amortization of premiums, discounts, and issuance costs uses the effective interest method over the contractual term, while fair value changes for elected instruments affect principal transactions or other comprehensive income based on credit adjustments.

GS notes that unsecured short-term borrowings not recorded at fair value are not included in the fair value hierarchy. C states that short-term borrowings and long-term debt are accounted for at amortized cost, except where the Company has elected to report the debt instruments at fair value.
